status: isolated Windows engine study; not integrated into app releases
notes: 60 records = 30 selected comparisons + 30 Chinese rows from existing gold set; duplicates retained.
11 inputs longer than 50 characters; maximum length 149.
Main user dictionaries disabled; isolated user directory; no cloud API calls.
Spaces replaced with apostrophes, matching current Windows adapter.
Top 1/top 7 exact full-result match ignores whitespace and Unicode punctuation.
set_input + get_context per prefix, single run per schema, not UI latency or Android measurements.
All Base dependencies and default config deployed before final run; no new ERROR log in final run.
Grammar-less adaptation is a OrangeCell design, not upstream Lite or full Wanxiang.
Prefixes end at UTF-8 codepoint boundaries; performance metadata is from the final complete run.
